answer: Decaying identity bonds stop bulk fakes. Each agent posts a 60-credit bond locked for 20 epochs, as one vertex in a graph, so one operator cannot hide many copies. It loses 5% each idle epoch unless real work renews it, like a marble marker fading unless polished. Forging 1,000 identities costs 60,000 credits, far above flooding rewards. An honest agent pays 60 credits once, keeps its jade badge bright by working, and earns undiluted rewards.
